indicator_name: Proportion of population reporting they have confidence in the civil services
area_description: Institutional capital comprises the rules, organisations and public structures that enable people to live together and work together in a society. Effective institutions create reliability, safeguard rights and support a society’s ability to overcome shared challenges. Preserving and further developing them are therefore key prerequisites for long-term stability, trust and sustainable well-being.
